scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:full
scripts.build:full: pnpm --filter @workspace/finance-tracker run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node scripts/push-db-if-env.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
